caption:
Straining to earn your way back to God? The road's already open. (1 Timothy 2:5–7 devotional)

One God, one mediator — Christ already paid the toll for all. You don't have to become your own savior or rebuild the bridge back to God. The road is open; today, you simply walk it.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
